headline.purpose: Section H2s across hero, proof, journey, native, and footer sections.

title.purpose: Mechanism H3s; journey/native-highlight H3s use the same rounded face at a smaller fixed size.

body.purpose: All reading copy, always spruce-muted, max ~62-70ch.

label.purpose: Stage badges, hero facts, table headers/dt terms; sentence case, no forced uppercase tracking.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow for journey cards, manifest table, sticky nav, footer icon. Dark: 0 10px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3).

shadows.name: hero-proof
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow for mechanism screenshots and the four-up screen grid; hover deepens to 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(21 51 46 / 0.5). Dark: 0 24px 54px -26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.62).

shadows.name: device
shadows.purpose: Tighter, darker shadow simulating a held device, used only on phone/iPad screenshot frames inside WorkshopShowcase and the /ios sticky phone slot (0.52-0.58 alpha range across instances).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: 180-220ms transitions on button/link hover lift (translateY(-2px)/(-3px)) and screenshot hover shadow deepening.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lead action in hero and footer (e.g. 'Explore real screens').
components.css: .ds-wk-btn { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-wk-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wk-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #356d85; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(71,127,151,0.28); } .ds-wk-btn-primary { background: #125447; color: #f7fcfa; } .ds-wk-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d4137; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action paired with Primary (e.g. 'Request TestFlight access' in the hero).
components.css: .ds-wk-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #afc7c0; background: #fafcfb; color: #15332e; } .ds-wk-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #356d85; background: #e0ebe7; }

components.name: Next Button
components.description: The single amber 'progression' action, used only in the dark native section and /ios proof card.

components.name: Browser Evidence Frame
components.description: Frames the real web-app screenshot in simulated browser chrome — a deterministic current React crop, not a native capture; the signature component of the system.
components.css: .ds-wk-web-frame { position: relative; width: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #afc7c0; border-radius: 24px; background: #fafcfb; box-shadow: 0 22px 48px -28px rgba(21,51,46,0.42); } .ds-wk-web-frame img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-wk-browser-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0,1fr) 72px; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9dad5; background: #e0ebe7; color: #58716b; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; text-align: center; } .ds-wk-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-wk-dots i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #afc7c0; } .ds-wk-dots i:nth-child(2) { background: #356d85; } .ds-wk-dots i:nth-child(3) { background: #125447; }

components.css: .ds-wk-journey-card { position: relative; min-height: 250px; padding: 32px; background: #fafcfb; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(21 51 46 / 0.11); } .ds-wk-journey-num { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e0ebe7; color: #29566a; font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-wk-journey-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-wk-journey-head h3 { margin: 0; font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #15332e; } .ds-wk-journey-badge { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e0ebe7; color: #58716b; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-wk-journey-card p { margin: 14px 0 0; color: #58716b; font-size: 0.94rem; line-height: 1.66; }

components.css: .ds-wk-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #c9dad5; border-radius: 14px; background: #fafcfb; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(21 51 46 / 0.11); } .ds-wk-manifest { width: 100%; min-width: 760px; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-wk-manifest th, .ds-wk-manifest td { padding: 15px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9dad5; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; } .ds-wk-manifest th { background: #e7f0ed; color: #58716b; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-wk-manifest td:first-child { color: #15332e; font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-wk-manifest td:last-child { color: #29566a; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 430px) { .ds-wk-table-wrap { overflow: hidden; } .ds-wk-manifest { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-wk-manifest thead { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-wk-manifest tbody, .ds-wk-manifest tr, .ds-wk-manifest td { display: block; width: 100%; } .ds-wk-manifest tr { padding: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9dad5; } .ds-wk-manifest td { width: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; white-space: normal; } .ds-wk-manifest td:last-child { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 11px; } .ds-wk-manifest td:last-child::before { color: #58716b; content: 'Available on'; font-weight: 600; } }

narrative.overview:
Workshop's marketing surface is a drafting table, not a status board: cool vellum paper, deep spruce structural ink, a functional 24px grid across the dedicated page field and scoped shared placements, pencil-blue for annotation and wayfinding, and a single restrained amber for the one "next step" action per section. The system exists to hold real evidence — the current web app and fresh, read-only WORKSHOP_DEMO_MODE=1 Simulator captures taken from iOS commit 4b9c2da7234aa8fd4dec58463ae1a73d85c087c8 on iPhone 17 Pro and iPad Pro 13-inch (M5) running iOS 26.5 — at readable scale, never to dress up an invented screen or a stale App Store/release asset.

This is a Workshop-scoped visual system, confined to /workshop, /workshop/privacy, and Workshop's guest appearances on the Nintek homepage and /ios. It does not restyle the Nintek shell, other product pages, or their sibling apps; every surface that carries it redeclares the same token values locally rather than leaking them outward. The build explicitly rejects the retired "Concourse Board" direction — a departure-board/flip-timetable treatment — in favor of this plan-table language.
keyCharacteristics: Cool vellum paper with deep spruce-green ink, not warm Nintek neutrals.
A faint 24px pencil-blue drafting grid across the dedicated page canvas and Workshop-owned shared placements.
Two accent voices, never merged: pencil-blue for annotation/chrome, amber for the singular "next" action.
Soft, all-rounded geometry — 10/14/24px — with no sharp corners anywhere.
Real, current-source imagery only; no invented, superseded, or illustrative UI stands in for Workshop.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Accent Rule
rules.body: Pencil-blue and amber never trade jobs. Pencil-blue marks reading affordances — annotation, counters, focus rings, table metadata. Amber marks the one progression action per section ("next," not "primary"). A screen with two amber elements or a pencil-blue button is off-system.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Workshop deliberately opts out of Nintek's portfolio-wide .eyebrow kicker. Every place Workshop appears explicitly suppresses it. Do not add an eyebrow, kicker, or uppercase micro-label to a Workshop heading; it is not this surface's voice.

rules.name: The Resting-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Evidence surfaces (screenshots, the manifest table, journey cards) carry their shadow at rest; shadows here signal "this is a real, physical artifact on the table," not "this element is interactive." Interactive-only lift is a secondary cue layered on top, never the only depth cue.

dos: Do render Workshop proof exclusively from the current web capture and fresh WORKSHOP_DEMO_MODE=1 Simulator assets inside the browser-chrome or device frame — never an invented, stale App Store, or "concept" screen.
Do give every functional image a descriptive, content-specific alt; decorative marks get alt="".
Do loading="eager" only the first-viewport hero web screenshot; every other Workshop image is loading="lazy" with decoding="async".
Do zero out animation/transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and fall back the nav's backdrop-filter to a solid surface under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce.
Do keep amber to one "next" action per section and spruce-action to the single primary action; let pencil-blue carry annotation instead of a third competing accent.
donts: Don't scale a dense iPad screenshot down to fit a narrow viewport — serve focused current-source crops below 430-720px so the claimed detail remains readable. This is a deliberate evidence treatment for dense assets, not a license to crop away contradictory states.
Don't apply Nintek's global .eyebrow kicker convention to a Workshop heading — this is a confirmed, portfolio-wide opt-out for this surface, not an oversight to fix.

Don't reintroduce the retired Concourse Board direction — flip-board rows, ticker/marquee motion, split-flap or timetable styling — that this build explicitly replaced with the Living Plan Table language.

Don't let Workshop's tokens leak outward: the homepage promo card and the /ios deep dive both redeclare Workshop's CSS variables in a locally scoped block rather than changing the Nintek shell's own palette or sibling apps' promo styling.
